title: Car skidding or hydroplaning: what to do
metaDesc: Car sliding on water, snow or ice? Ease off the gas, look and steer where you want to go, and don't slam the brakes. How to brake with and without ABS.
first: Take your foot off the gas.
Look and steer where you want the car to go. Keep your steering smooth.
Don't slam the brakes. If you need to brake, brake gently and smoothly. Your owner's manual explains how your car's brakes work in a skid.
As the car straightens out, straighten the wheels.
Once you have control, slow down. Pull off the road if you need a minute.

steps.t: The tires ride up on a layer of water and lose grip. Ease off the gas, keep the wheel steady, and don't brake hard until you feel the tires grip again.
Slow down before you need to. It's much harder to steer and stop on slick roads, so leave a lot more space.
If you're stuck, see Stuck in snow. If you hit something or someone, see I was in a crash.

call: Call 911 if anyone is hurt or the car is stuck somewhere dangerous.
